authority: Independent purposive research experiment; requirements are project posits, not verified user needs.

sampling.unit: A locally identifiable XML fragment in a published scholarly edition, with full source context retained at admission.
sampling.discovery_bound: At most four publicly accessible edition repository candidates; select three cases, preferably within one licensed edition corpus.
inclusion: Actual editorial source XML, not a tutorial-only example
An exact immutable version or dated snapshot
Source publication and editorial context identified
Rights and attribution reviewed before redistribution
exclusion: Unresolved rights for the intended stored representation
Synthetic or Guidelines-only examples presented as real practice
target_tasks: Inspect hierarchy and mixed content without losing textual order
Preserve an editorial distinction that challenges one contiguous structural extent
Expose an adverse unsupported feature without silently flattening it
biases: A single edition cannot represent the diversity of TEI practice
sampling.holdout: One adverse source fragment is withheld from mapper development and evaluated only after the mapping rules are fixed. It is not a statistically independent test of an architecture designed with knowledge of the problem family.

candidates: Versioned character sequence with attributed contiguous forests and explicit annotations
Primary tree with separately identified stand-off observations
comparison.oracle: Case-specific expected text, structural distinctions, target observations, and declared losses are authored before mapper results are seen.

outputs.cases: Authored requirements and immutable source locators in cases.json; never a grounding target.
outputs.report: Generated deterministic comparison report with input fingerprints; never hand edited and never a grounding target.
outputs.profile: An optional profile of existing v0.1 records; core validation remains separate from profile conformance.
